sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To develop from user requirements an introduction to design of passive environmental systems for buildings, their integration into building fabric and structural systems, and selection of appropriate equipment and materials
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Explain the implications of urban and architectural development for local and global environmental resources and vice versa. B. Exemplify bioclimatic design principles at the urban/site and architectural scale for a variety of climatic regions. C. Demonstrate strategies for building services and integrated renewable energy generation and an ability to integrate these within the precepts of sustainable urban and building design. D. Critically evaluate and generate optimised sustainable design solutions, adopting digital software and AI design tools in support of the analysis.
